extra.summary: The HSBC Live+ Card shines for lifestyle spenders seeking boosted cashback on dining, shopping, and entertainment, both locally and overseas. Earn up to 8% cashback on Dining, Shopping, Entertainment spends and 5% cashback on Petrol spends. The Live+ Dining Programme provide extra value for frequent diners.

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Annual Interest Rate: Effective Rate: 27.8% p.a. (minimum), Minimum Charge: S$2.50
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Annual Principal Fee: S$196.2 (inclusive of GST). First-year annual fee waived
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Fee Waiver: For the second year onwards, we'll waive the Annual Fee for your card if you spend more than S$12,500 per year
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Minimum Monthly Repayment: 100% of the monthly instalment plan amount and interest/fees, 1% of remaining outstanding balances, excess amount above your credit limit (if your account is overlimit) or $50 (in the currency of your account), whichever is greater

minimum-income-requirements.Singaporean/PR Minimum Annual Income:
(a) Singaporeans, Singapore Permanent Residents: SGD 65,000 OR 
 (b) Singapore Citizens / Permanent Residents with HSBC total relationship balance (“TRB”)* of at least SGD50,000: SGD 30,000 for salaried employees 
 SGD 40,000 for self-employed or commission-based (*Total Relationship Balance (TRB) refers to the total value of your deposits, investments, and insurance with HSBC Bank (Singapore) Limited, calculated based on the average monthly balance over the last 3 months.)

our_takes.our-take: The HSBC Live+ Card shines for lifestyle spenders seeking boosted cashback on dining, shopping, and entertainment, both locally and overseas. The 8% rate is attractive, but remember the cashback is capped at SGD250 per quarter and requires minimum monthly spending of SGD600 (existing customers) or SGD1,000 per quarter (new customers). Consider whether your spending habits align, as other HSBC cards might offer better value if your spending is concentrated in other areas, or you want unlimited cashback. The Live+ Dining Programme provide extra value for frequent diners.
our_takes.good-for:
Young adults and social butterflies seeking high cashback on dining, entertainment, and shopping expenses.
Individuals who frequently drive and want to save money with cashback on petrol purchases at Caltex and Shell.
Shoppers who spend at least $600 monthly to unlock the card's full cashback potential on everyday lifestyle expenses.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Meeting the $600 monthly spend is crucial; falling short means missing out on the 8% cashback benefit.
Watch the $250 quarterly cashback cap; spending beyond it won't earn extra rewards on dining and shopping.
Be aware of the 27.8% p.a. interest rate; carrying balances will result in significant finance charges owed.
